Title: Highfield Therapy
Paragraph: Welcome to Highfield Therapy. My name is Robert, I am a qualified registrant counsellor with NCPS and follow their code of ethics. I am a humanistic therapist, with a focus on Transactional Analysis (TA) and I provide professional therapy services to help you navigate life's challenges. I offer online counselling but I offer counselling from home in a private garden room where you can talk openly about your concerns. I am a 20mins walk from Sheffield Central station or close to a tram stop. There is plenty of free on-street parking. Price £50, but offer concessions to those on low or no income.
